There are no margin or growth fields. `net_income` is one quarter; the trailing-twelve-month figure is `annual_net_income`. `pe_ratio` divides market cap by a full year of net income: `pe_basis` says whether that year came from a trailing-twelve-month filing (`ttm`), an annual one (`annual`), or, only when neither is available, four times the newest quarter (`quarterly_x4`). It is null when the full-year figure is zero or a loss, even if the newest quarter was profitable. `operating_cash_flow` prefers the trailing-twelve-month cash flow row and otherwise takes the newest row that has one; `operating_cash_flow_period` names it. Fundamentals for the given symbol, inside a `fundamentals` object beside `symbol` and `timestamp`. The fields are `revenue`, `net_income`, `eps`, `debt_to_equity`, `market_cap`, `total_assets`, `total_liabilities`, `filing_date` and `fiscal_period` from the newest quarterly filing; `annual_net_income`, `annual_net_income_period` and `annual_net_income_basis` for the trailing twelve months (or the newest annual filing); `operating_cash_flow` and `operating_cash_flow_period`; and `pe_ratio` with `pe_basis`. There are no margin or growth fields. `net_income` is one quarter; the trailing-twelve-month figure is `annual_net_income`. `pe_ratio` divides market cap by a full year of net income: `pe_basis` says whether that year came from a trailing-twelve-month filing (`ttm`), an annual one (`annual`), or, only when neither is available, four times the newest quarter (`quarterly_x4`). It is null when the full-year figure is zero or a loss, even if the newest quarter was profitable. `operating_cash_flow` prefers the trailing-twelve-month cash flow row and otherwise takes the newest row that has one; `operating_cash_flow_period` names it. Any field is null when the filing does not carry it. Gate on `pe_basis` if a `quarterly_x4` estimate is not good enough for your screen.
